title: Equivalence edges in a functor simplicial set are detected at vertices
statement: Use quasicategories, equivalence edges and the internal functor simplicial sets of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $\mathcal C$ be a quasicategory, let $K$ be any small simplicial set, let $F,G:K\to\mathcal C$ be diagrams, and let $\tau:F\to G$ be an edge of $\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal C)$, equivalently a map $K\times\Delta^1\to\mathcal C$ with these endpoints. Then $\tau$ is an equivalence edge if and only if for every vertex $k\in K$ its component $\tau|_{\{k\}\times\Delta^1}:F(k)\to G(k)$ is an equivalence edge of $\mathcal C$.
